MANIPULATION.R1: Rifles must always be treated as if they are loaded and handled accordingly.
MANIPULATION.R2: When it is not the shooter’s turn, the rifle must be placed on the firing line with the bolt open, magazine removed, and chamber empty.
MANIPULATION.R3: Any breach of this rule will result in immediate exclusion from the current round.

EPI.R1: Wearing safety glasses is strongly recommended for all shooters and assistants near the firing line.
EPI.R2: Hearing protection is optional but recommended for greater comfort during extended sessions.

CIBLES.R1: After each series, the referee or organizer must visually inspect the gongs and their supports.
CIBLES.R2: Any target showing defects (dangerous angle, cracks, suspension issues) must be replaced or removed immediately.
CIBLES.R3: Approved steel targets (AR400 or AR500, minimum thickness 3 mm) are mandatory to avoid perforation risks.

COMPORTEMENT.R1: Shooters must always comply with the instructions of the referee or range officer.
COMPORTEMENT.R2: No movement forward of the firing line is permitted without the referee’s approval.
COMPORTEMENT.R3: Any breach of safety rules will result in immediate exclusion of the shooter.
